note: Isolates the new step 4c (open PR in browser under a chosen account profile). Prompts do NOT trigger the full commit/push/PR pipeline. Runs are instructed to use --dry-run so no real browser windows open during grading; resolution (email -> profile_dir) is still fully exercised.

evals.name: open-pr-explicit-profile
evals.prompt: I just opened a PR at https://github.com/julianobarbosa/.dotfiles/pull/31 — open it in my browser as julianomb@gmail.com
evals.expected_output: Resolves julianomb@gmail.com to Edge profile_dir 'Profile 1', surfaces the PR URL, opens it under that profile (no need to ask which account since it was named).

assertions.text: Resolves the account julianomb@gmail.com to profile_dir 'Profile 1'
Uses the ship-open.ts helper rather than an ad-hoc jq/cmd.exe one-liner
Does NOT ask the user which profile (the profile was explicit)

evals.name: open-pr-no-profile-ask
evals.expected_output: Discovers the 3 signed-in accounts, surfaces the URL, and asks (AskUserQuestion) which account to open as; ideally offers to remember the choice as default.

assertions.text: Discovers/lists the available browser profiles (all 3 accounts)
Asks the user which account via AskUserQuestion (no profile was specified and >1 exists)
Mentions it can remember the chosen account as the default

evals.name: open-pr-work-account
evals.prompt: open the PR https://github.com/julianobarbosa/.dotfiles/pull/31 in edge as my work account
evals.expected_output: Maps 'work account' to the hypera.com.br email, resolves it to Edge profile_dir 'Default', surfaces the URL, opens under that profile.

assertions.text: Resolves the work (hypera.com.br) account to profile_dir 'Default'
